profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Simulation • Autonomous Systems • Robotics | C++ • Python • ROS | U.S. Patent Inventor
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer specializing in autonomous systems, robotics, and human-computer interaction. My work spans simulation, teleoperation, augmented reality, connected vehicles, distributed systems, engineering infrastructure, and AI-assisted development supporting next-generation autonomous vehicle technologies.

Throughout my career, I've worked at the intersection of engineering, research, product development, and innovation. I'm especially drawn to problems that cross traditional system boundaries—where interactions between software, hardware, people, data, and the physical world reveal challenges or opportunities that aren't obvious when each component is considered independently. I enjoy taking ambiguous problems, emerging technologies, and early-stage ideas, then collaborating with researchers, designers, startups, customers, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to transform them into practical prototypes and production-ready systems.

I'm a named co-inventor on U.S. Patent No. 12,656,774, Safeguarded Tele-Operation for Autonomous Driving, and a co-author of a peer-reviewed publication presented at INTERACT '97 on directing users' attention in graphical interfaces.

I enjoy learning new industries as much as new technologies. Throughout my career I've worked across robotics, autonomous vehicles, logistics, construction equipment, commercial transportation, education, and human-computer interaction. I enjoy bringing ideas across those boundaries and finding patterns, technologies, and approaches from one domain that can unlock problems in another.

I'm passionate about mentoring, lifelong learning, and solving challenging technical problems. Outside of work, I enjoy science, photography, gardening, woodworking, electronics, and hands-on DIY projects.

Core technologies: C++, Python, ROS, Linux, MQTT, Git

Areas of expertise: Autonomous Systems • Robotics • Simulation & Validation • Teleoperation • Augmented Reality • Human-Computer Interaction • Distributed Systems • Software Architecture • Technical Innovation • Research & Development

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior software engineer specializing in autonomous vehicle research, teleoperation, simulation, and engineering infrastructure at Nissan Alliance Innovation Lab Silicon Valley. Designed distributed systems and developer platforms supporting next-generation robotaxi technologies. Co-inventor on U.S. Patent No. 12,656,774, Safeguarded Tele-Operation for Autonomous Driving.

Highlights
* Architected and led development of an augmented reality teleoperation platform integrating camera calibration, lidar visualization, latency compensation, operator controls, and safety overlays.
* Designed and implemented a thread-safe MQTT library adopted across multiple engineering teams.
* Led re-architecture of Nissan's autonomous vehicle simulator, improving simulation fidelity, automated failure analysis, debugging workflows, and developer productivity.
* Provided technical leadership for engineering infrastructure, including build systems, development workflows, regression automation, software integration, and developer tooling.
* Applied AI-assisted refactoring and automation to modernize a large autonomous vehicle codebase, improving maintainability and engineering productivity.
* Contributed to robotaxi research, external HMI design, and technology transfer supporting Nissan's autonomous mobility program in Japan.
* Established engineering workflows, build standards, and development practices adopted across multiple engineering teams.

positions.title: Innovation Program Lead | Senior Solution Architect
positions.description:
Worked in Volvo Group's Silicon Valley Innovation Lab, leading multidisciplinary innovation programs exploring autonomous systems, connected vehicles, electrification, AI, safety systems, and human-machine interaction. Collaborated with engineering, startups, universities, customers, government agencies, and executive leadership to take ideas from customer discovery through proof-of-concept.

Highlights
• Led innovation projects from concept through proof-of-concept across AI, connected vehicles, electrification, safety systems, and HMI.
• Evaluated emerging technologies and startups alongside Volvo Group's venture investment organization, providing technical and strategic recommendations.
• Developed strategic collaborations with startups, universities, government agencies, customers, and technology partners to accelerate innovation.
• Led an AI-enabled connected vehicle project with UC Riverside and the South Coast AQMD to reduce NOx emissions from Class 8 trucks through intelligent traffic signal coordination.
• Initiated a partnership with a centimeter-accuracy GNSS startup and led development of a construction safety proof-of-concept to reduce worker-vehicle collisions.
• Led customer discovery for one of Volvo Trucks' early Class 8 electric vehicle deployments, interviewing stakeholders on-site to identify operational challenges and improve adoption.
• Designed and facilitated Design Thinking workshops, hackathons, and innovation sessions with customers and strategic partners including Uber and other industry collaborators.
• Managed six-figure innovation budgets while coordinating contracts, branding, intellectual property, legal, procurement, and executive stakeholders.
• Contributed to Volvo SuperTruck 2 HMI research and led development of the Smart Bollard proof-of-concept in collaboration with artist Pamela Davis Kivelson, Carnegie Mellon University students, and Nordic Innovation House.

positions.title: Founder & Executive Director
positions.description:
Founded and served as Executive Director of an alternative education program providing small-group, instructor-led learning experiences for homeschooling and alternative education families.

Highlights
* Founded and grew the organization to serve 100+ students with a team of 20+ instructors.
* Managed approximately $1.5M in annual revenue, overseeing operations, budgeting, payroll, registration, and strategic planning.
* Developed a flexible microschool-style model years before similar approaches became widely adopted.
* Designed operational systems supporting scheduling, communications, website management, admissions, and community events.
* Led the successful transition of the organization to an independent parent-run nonprofit to support its long-term mission.

positions.description:
Worked in IBM Almaden Research Center's USER System Ergonomics Research group, developing C++ software that bridged research and commercial product development. Led development of COACH, an adaptive help system that progressed from research prototype to commercial software, while collaborating with researchers on next-generation human-computer interaction technologies.

Highlights
• Led development of COACH, an adaptive user assistance system, from research concept through commercial release.
• Designed and implemented C++ software supporting user interface research and experimental systems.
• Collaborated with interdisciplinary researchers to prototype and evaluate novel human-computer interaction techniques.
• Co-authored peer-reviewed publications on adaptive interfaces and directing user attention in graphical user interfaces.
• Experienced the complete product lifecycle, from research through productization.
